name: Corner convenience store (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Single-storey corner convenience store, 10 x 12 m: grey brick with full-height shopfront glazing on the street front and round the corner, a glazed double door, a green blank fascia sign band on both street faces and a projecting blank disc sign. Inside: the shop with three fixed shelving gondolas, a wall shelving run, a glass-door chiller line, a counter with till and a back gantry; a back store room with racking and a rear door.
